impacts.text: Off-chain indexer corruption: Services tracking token balances via Transfer events (The Graph, Dune Analytics, custom indexers) will have completely incorrect balance data.
Token owners appearing to never lose tokens (balance never decreases)
Spenders appearing to have negative balances (impossible state)
Block explorer incorrect data: Etherscan, Blockscout, and other explorers will display incorrect transfer history showing the wrong sender
DeFi integration failures: Protocols relying on Transfer events for:
Wallet tracking issues: Wallets that use event logs to track token movements will show incorrect transaction history
it causes significant integration issues and data corruption for any system relying on ERC20 Transfer events

ambiguities: DeFi integration failure sub-items (balance reconciliation, transaction history, accounting and auditing, tax reporting tools) are listed as categories without separately stated outcomes
No direct loss of funds is stated
